It is reported from al-Ḥasan: "ʿAqabah, by God, is a hard path," the struggle of a person against his self, his desire, and his enemy, Satan. Fakk al-raqabah (freeing a neck) means releasing it from slavery or other bondage.

It is in a ḥadīth that a man said to the Messenger of God (ﷺ): "Direct me to a deed that will admit me to Paradise." He said: "Free the soul (nasamah) and free the neck (raqabah)."
